items.title: The hidden pressure behind responding to a boss's good news
items.summary: Have you ever found yourself listening to someone share their good news and felt pressure to respond with excitement, even if you didn't feel particularly enthusiastic? Does that pressure feel even greater when the person sharing the news is your boss?

items.title: Empty nets in Latin America as fish flee El Niño
items.summary: Fishermen along Latin America's Pacific coast are reeling in half-empty nets as ocean warming aggravated by El Niño causes tuna, anchovies and other top catches to migrate to cooler waters.

items.title: Hrvatski fizičari s PMF-a otkrili neobično magnetsko stanje
items.summary: FIZIČARI Mihael Grbić, Ivan Jakovac i Ivan Kupčić s Prirodoslovno-matematičkog fakulteta u Zagrebu predvodili su međunarodni tim koji je otkrio neobično magnetsko stanje u slojevitom materijalu.

items.title: Study shows how research can change person conducting it
items.summary: In 2012, I began an interview study with two multilingual language learners, focusing on their motivations for learning languages. It eventually developed into a nine-year longitudinal study.
